description: This file defines the SuiteInvocationStrategy class implementing the InvocationStrategyInterface. It provides an __invoke method to process route arguments and invoke a callable with a modified request object, supporting specific routing behavior within a Slim framework application.

classes.name: SuiteInvocationStrategy
classes.description: Implements the InvocationStrategyInterface, providing custom invocation logic for route handling within the framework.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the provided callable with a modified request object, passing route arguments and optional parameters from the request attributes.
